authority.fallback_reason: Codex (the ordered Tier 1 primary reviewer) was not usable at review time in this local environment; the canonical OpenCode hostile review guard recorded exhaustive attempts against every enabled pool reviewer before recording this guard review.

reviewer_attempts.reason: Codex is not available for review at this time in this local environment.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The trusted default branch declares an ordered reviewer pool (Codex tier 1, approved agent reviewers tier 2, the canonical OpenCode hostile review last resort) with a bounded, documented, machine-checkable timeout policy.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/CODE_WRITE_POLICY.json declares review_authority.reviewer_pool with ordered Codex primary and opencode last resort; scripts/hunter_pre_ready_review.py _pool_problems and load_reviewer_pool structurally validate ordering, unique priorities, Codex enabled at priority 1, enabled exact-head support, fallback_eligibility false, bounded timeout_policy with default_seconds <= max_seconds, and per-agent timeout_seconds within the bound.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Failover is deterministic and machine-checkable: any reviewer below the primary is admissible only with recorded exhaustion evidence (status exhausted, reason, in-bound timeout_seconds) for every higher-priority enabled reviewer; a new commit stale-binds the review and restarts selection.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pre_ready_review.py _authority_error loads the shared pool and _exhaustion_error enforces reviewer_attempts: status == 'exhausted', non-empty reason, timeout_seconds within 1..max_seconds, no duplicates, no unknown agents; verify_local re-binds exact HEAD with full-SHA equality and ancestry; regression tests in tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py cover alternate-after-exhaustion, stale restart, unproven exhaustion, skipped blocker, bounded timeout, unknown agent, and malformed trail.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The guard (OpenCode hostile review) remains strict last resort: admissible only when the whole enabled pool is exhausted and the green snapshot gates (governance, trusted preflight, zero unresolved threads, complete structured evidence) are recorded.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pre_ready_review.py _authority_error triggers _exhaustion_error against the full enabled pool when authority_type equals the declared last resort; fallback_requires_snapshot_gates checks and the guard tests in tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py assert guard exhaustion + gate requirements remain mandatory after pool hardening.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The review verifier and the Defect Prevention guard parse the same shared pool implementation so they cannot drift into two readings of the same reviewer order or timeout policy.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_defect_prevention_preflight.py imports hunter_pre_ready_review as pre_ready and calls pre_ready.load_reviewer_pool(policy); the guard path is covered by the code-write-policy tests; load_reviewer_pool is the single canonical parser consumed by both the local verifier and the guard.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Bypass fails closed: skips, missing/duplicated/malformed/unknown-agent or out-of-bounds exhaustion records are blocked; a review that silently skips an enabled reviewer while it is available is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Regression tests in tests/test_issue_412_prevention_gate.py and tests/test_code_write_policy.py assert skipped-status blocked, unknown agent blocked, out-of-bounds timeout blocked, disabled agent neither admissible nor required, missing attempts rejected and duplicate attempts rejected; the guard rejects a pool without a strict last resort and an unbounded timeout policy.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: DFF-022 is extended to describe the ordered failover invariant, exhaustion evidence, bounded timeout policy, strict-last-resort guard semantics, and regression evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/DEFECT_REGISTRY.json DFF-022 invariant and mechanism updated with ordered pool, exhaustion evidence, bounded timeout_policy, last-resort guard, stale-restart; regression evidence includes the new failover and pool-gate tests.

defect_families.evidence: DFF-022 extended with ordered reviewer-pool failover, bounded timeout, last-resort guard, stale-restart, and exhaustion-evidence regression tests in this candidate; the other applicable families were swept against this change set with no recurrence found.
